title: Calculator Locator
keywords: Owner-bound FE generator whose plug platform and stable boards determine valid operation and instability

blocks.text: Owner-bound FE generator whose plug platform and stable boards determine valid operation and instability.

rows: Bind and insert a Locator Module.
Build the square of plugs, base blocks and outside wall.
Insert stable analysed boards in plugs.
Provide output space or a battery to receive generated energy.

blocks.text: Below the stabilization threshold the owner must be nearby in the same dimension. A bound module is not a replacement for a valid structure.
